logo.title: The Shutter Window.
logo.lead: A window with two louvred shutter panels: it shows exactly what they make, and reads as a sturdy, honest shopfront mark. Ochre slats bring warmth. The wordmark is "Abbott's" in Playfair Display, a Victorian-era serif for a Victorian-era firm.

story.title: Dressing East London's homes since 1882.
story.lead: Abbott's has been trading on Roman Road since 1882, perhaps the oldest surviving trader on one of London's oldest market streets. Today it's a 470m² showroom of blinds, shutters, curtains and flooring. The brand should feel like a beautifully finished room: warm, considered, crafted, and still local.
story.positioning: Roman Road's oldest trader. Made-to-measure blinds, shutters and flooring, with 140 years of know-how.

colour.title: Charcoal, linen, ochre.
colour.lead: Charcoal and linen are the calm neutrals of a well-dressed room. Ochre is warm timber and brass fittings. Sage and oak are supporting accents for product categories. Let the photography of real rooms carry the colour.

type.title: Victorian serif, modern sans.
type.lead: Playfair Display nods to 1882 with elegant contrast. Figtree is modern and friendly for product details and booking. Both are free on Google Fonts.

samples.label: Body
samples.text: Visit our 470m² showroom on Roman Road: thousands of fabrics, finishes and floors.

voice.title: Expert, warm, never pushy.
voice.lead: Talk like the fitter who's measured ten thousand windows: practical advice first, sales second.
pairs: "Not sure between shutters and blinds? We'll bring samples and talk you through it."
"Come and see 470m² of samples on Roman Road."

imagery.title: Real rooms, real light.
imagery.lead: Finished installs in East London homes (with permission), with morning light through shutters and close-ups of fabric, grain and fittings. Show the showroom floors, and the family and fitters at work. Avoid glossy stock interiors that look nothing like a Bow terrace.
